title: The startup using AI to help rare disease families develop custom treatments
summary: Nome is an innovative startup that leverages artificial intelligence to assist families affected by rare diseases in developing personalized treatment options. By combining AI technology with drug-development expertise, Nome aims to transform genetic diagnoses into actionable treatment pathways. This approach not only empowers families but also represents a significant advancement in the field of rare disease management.
